_comment: This configuration file is used by the Spotfuck music player. API keys can be stored here for automatic loading from GitHub repositories. For security, consider using a private repository or environment variables for production deployments.

jamendo._comment: Jamendo Client ID - Get from jamendo.com. The default ID 'c4ce16c7' is for the free tier and should work immediately.

youtube._comment: ENTER YOUR YOUTUBE DATA API V3 KEY HERE - Get from console.cloud.google.com. Required for YouTube music streaming. Leave empty to use Audius (FREE) instead.

spotify._comment: ENTER YOUR SPOTIFY CREDENTIALS HERE - Get from developer.spotify.com. Required for Spotify integration (30-second previews only). Leave empty to use Audius (FREE) instead.

audius._comment: Audius is FREE and requires no API keys. Works out of the box - no setup required!

downloads._comment: Download feature is only available for Audius and Jamendo due to API restrictions

library._comment: Library features for managing saved tracks
